disclaimer: Context only — an AI reading of the radar's own deterministic output, not a signal. It feeds no score or allocation, can be wrong or overconfident, and every claim cites the radar evidence it is based on. Graded against the tape over time; treat as odds, not a forecast.

assessments.rationale: The strongest signal is [P3] regulatory pipeline z=3.5, but this is an unusually narrow basis for the whole theme: the other six per-source readings are all below 0.3, with Congress net-buy at 0.025 and news flow at 0.0. The fused acceleration of 2.604 is almost entirely carried by that single regulatory reading. [P1] calls POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE but lifecycle is 'forming', which fits the weak breadth. On continuity, [P2] shows activity ahead of price (z 2.785), yet [P4] confirms price is not participating: 60-day relative strength vs SPY is -0.2671 at z -2.053, dir -1, i.e. the market has moved the other way with statistical force. [P5] has velocity only 1.2 and accelerating negatively (-0.333), so there is no information flow to drag price toward the real-activity signal. Verdict MONITOR: real-activity is real but narrow, price is deeply behind, and the news engine has not started.
assessments.rationale_zh: 最强的信号是 [P3] 中监管管线 z=3.5，但这作为整个主题的依据异常单薄：其余六个来源读数全部低于 0.3，国会净买入仅 0.025，新闻流为 0.0。融合加速 2.604 几乎完全由这一个监管读数承担。[P1] 称为正背离但生命周期为“形成中”，与弱势广度一致。连续性方面，[P2] 显示活动领先价格（z 2.785），但 [P4] 确认价格没有参与：60 天相对强弱势为 -0.2671，z -2.053，dir -1，市场以统计显著性朝相反方向运行。[P5] 流速仅 1.2 且加速度为负（-0.333），没有信息流动把价格向真实活动信号牵引。结论 MONITOR：真实活动真实但狭窄，价格严重落后，新闻引擎尚未启动。
assessments.rationale_plain: There is a real but narrow signal in the semiconductor equipment space: regulatory filings have surged sharply, which is typically an early sign of activity. However, almost nothing else is backing it up — congressional trading, corporate disclosures, grants, and news coverage are all flat. Meanwhile the market itself has been moving the other way, underperforming over the last sixty days despite this activity. The right posture is to wait: if the regulatory wave broadens into other channels and news flow starts to pick up, the setup becomes convincing; until then it is one loud signal in a quiet room.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 半导体设备领域存在一个真实但狭窄的信号：监管申报活动大幅上升，这通常是活动早期的迹象。但几乎没有其他方面配合——国会交易、公司披露、拨款和新闻报道都平淡。与此同时，市场本身在过去六十天里反方向运行，表现落后于大盘。正确的姿态是等待：如果监管浪潮扩散到其他渠道，新闻流开始加快，这个布局才会变得有说服力；在那之前，它只是一个安静房间里的响亮信号。
assessments.dissent: The regulatory-pipeline spike (z=3.5) may be a direct and proprietary federal signal that traditional market participants cannot see, and the POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE classification plus activity-ahead-of-price z=2.785 suggest the market is simply late, not wrong. If the regulatory signal is this extreme while price is at z -2.053, the asymmetry may favor entering before the information diffuses, because once news flow accelerates, price could reprice quickly and the entry window closes.

falsifiable_check.confirm: Within 4-6 weeks, at least two more per-source activity readings (e.g. news flow, 8-K material events, federal grant FOAs) exceed z=1.0, and 60-day relative strength turns positive (dir +1) while real-activity vs price divergence stays above 1.5.
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Regulatory pipeline z-score declines toward the rest of the pack (<1.5) with no improvement in news flow or market relative strength, or relative strength breaks below -0.30 with divergence fading below 1.0.

assessments.name: Semiconductor Equipment (WFE)
assessments.name_zh: 半导体设备（晶圆厂设备）

assessments.rationale: Strength is thin: the fused acceleration of 1.836 is driven almost entirely by Lobbying ramp (z=1.236), with Federal contracts only z=0.007 and Congress net-buy z=-0.726 [P3]. 8-K material events z=-1.465 and News flow z=-0.674 are negative, so real-activity breadth is narrow — one loud source, not seven [P3]. Durability is moderate: Lobbying ramp shows persistence potential, and the divergence is in a 'forming' lifecycle [P1], but no second source confirms the signal (Pre-award solicitations z=0.0, Federal contracts flat) [P3]. Continuity is weak: price is meaningfully behind (activity-vs-price divergence z=1.879 [P2]) and 60-day relative strength is deeply negative (z=-1.975, dir -1) [P4], so price has NOT followed the activity — either the market disagrees or has not noticed yet. News flow velocity 13.2 is flat-to-declining (accel -0.371), so the narrative is not spreading [P5]. Verdict MONITOR: activity is ahead of price but rests on a single source in a forming pattern; wait for a second confirming source or a price turn before entering.
assessments.rationale_zh: 强度偏弱：融合加速 1.836 几乎完全来自游说升温（z=1.236），联邦合同仅 z=0.007，国会净买入 z=-0.726 [P3]。8-K 重大事件 z=-1.465 和新闻流 z=-0.674 均为负值，实际活动广度狭窄——只有游说一个响亮来源 [P3]。持续性中等：游说升温有延续潜力，且处于'形成'阶段 [P1]，但没有第二个来源确认（招标前公告 z=0.0，联邦合同持平）[P3]。连续性弱：价格显著落后（活动-价格背离 z=1.879 [P2]），60日相对强度深负（z=-1.975）[P4]，价格尚未跟随活动——市场要么不认可，要么尚未察觉。新闻流速 13.2 且加速为负（-0.371），叙事没有扩散 [P5]。结论为观察：活动领先价格，但仅依赖单一来源且处于形成期；等待第二个确认来源或价格转向再进入。
assessments.rationale_plain: Lobbying activity in the space economy is picking up noticeably — well above its typical pace — but almost nothing else confirms the move: federal contracts are flat, Congress is slightly net-negative, and material corporate events are actually below normal. Prices have not responded at all; in fact, the space names in this group have underperformed the market sharply over the past sixty days, and news coverage is not accelerating. That combination — one real-world signal ahead of a price that has not moved — is worth watching, not acting on. Wait for either a second source (contracts, pre-award activity) to turn up or for price to start confirming before committing.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 太空经济领域的游说活动明显升温，明显高于平时水平，但几乎没有其他信号能佐证：联邦合同持平，国会净买入略偏负，重大企业事件甚至低于正常水平。价格完全未作反应——事实上，这批太空相关公司在过去六十天里明显跑输大盘，新闻报道也没有加速。只有一个现实信号跑在价格前面、而价格尚未跟上的组合，值得观察而非行动。等第二个来源（合同、招标前活动）转强，或价格开始确认后再介入。
assessments.dissent: The positive divergence (z=1.879) with a 'forming' lifecycle is the classic early-entry signature: activity leads price precisely because the market has not priced it yet, and fading early on single-source signals means missing the move. Lobbying ramp is a leading indicator — firms hire lobbyists before contracts land — so the weakness in Federal contracts and 8-Ks may simply be lagging indicators that will turn up next quarter. Waiting for confirmation could mean paying 20-30% higher.

falsifiable_check.confirm: Within 4-6 weeks, at least one additional source (Federal contracts, pre-award solicitations, or 8-K material events) turns positive, AND relative strength vs the market flattens or turns up (60-day relative strength z > -1.0).
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Within 4-6 weeks, Lobbying ramp z falls below 0.5 while Federal contracts and pre-award solicitations remain flat or negative, AND relative strength stays below z = -1.5 — indicating the lobbying spike was a one-off client push with no real contract pipeline behind it.

assessments.name: Space Economy

assessments.rationale: The activity breadth is genuinely narrow: only one source (Gov contracts, z=2.548) is doing heavy lifting while Congress net-buy (-0.095), Lobbying (0.115), and 8-K events (-0.363) are flat or negative [P3]. The fused acceleration of 3.756 sounds strong but rests on a single leg, which makes it fragile. Radar calls POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE in a forming lifecycle with real-activity vs price z=0.808, meaning activity is modestly ahead of price [P1][P2]. Price is not extended — 60-day relative strength vs SPY is slightly negative (-3.17%, z=0.068) and no news leg exists, so nothing is crowded yet [P4][P5]. The case is 'one strong government-contract signal, three sleepers, under-the-radar pricing' — worth monitoring for breadth confirmation.
assessments.rationale_zh: 活动广度确实很窄：只有一个来源（政府合同，z=2.548）在起主要作用，而国会净买入（-0.095）、游说（0.115）和8-K事件（-0.363）都持平或偏负 [P3]。融合加速度3.756听起来强，但建立在单一支腿上，因此脆弱。雷达显示正向背离、形态形成期，实际活动对价格z=0.808，意味着活动略微领先价格 [P1][P2]。价格并未超涨——60日相对强度对SPY略负（-3.17%，z=0.068），且无新闻腿，所以暂无拥挤 [P4][P5]。本案是'一个强政府合同信号、三个沉睡者、价格不显眼'——值得继续观察广度的确认。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government contracting tied to the telecom and media names in this sector has picked up sharply, but it is the only pocket of real-world activity moving right now — Washington trading, lobbying, and corporate filings are all quiet. The market has barely noticed: sector prices are roughly flat relative to the broader market over the past two months, and no news cycle has kicked in. That combination means the signal is real but narrow and unconfirmed. A patient approach is to wait for a second or third activity source to turn higher, or for prices to start reflecting the pickup, before committing.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 与该板块电信和媒体公司相关的政府合同活动明显升温，但这是目前唯一在动的现实世界活动——华盛顿交易、游说和公司申报都保持安静。市场几乎没有注意到：过去两个月板块价格相对于大盘基本持平，也没有新闻周期启动。这意味着信号真实但狭窄且尚未确认。耐心做法是等待第二或第三个活动来源转强，或等待价格开始反映这一升温，再考虑投入。
assessments.dissent: The single strongest case against waiting is that the fused acceleration (3.756) and the positive divergence z of 0.808 may be an early tell: when one source breaks out ahead of a quiet price tape, it can be the leading edge of a broader move, and waiting for multi-source confirmation risks missing the foundation stage entirely. If the Gov-contract signal is an idiosyncratic lump (one large award) rather than a trend, the entire narrative collapses — and the breadth data cannot distinguish trend from lump.

falsifiable_check.confirm: Two or more sources (Congress net-buy, Lobbying, 8-K) turn positive within the next 30 days while 60-day relative strength moves above zero.
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Gov contracts z falls below 1.5 within 30 days, or relative strength deteriorates further (below -5%) despite continued Gov-contract strength.

assessments.name: Communication Services (Equal-Weight)

assessments.rationale: Strength is moderate and narrowly sourced. [P3] shows fused acceleration of 2.175 across 4 sources, but the signal is carried almost entirely by two of them: Gov contracts z=1.61 and Lobbying ramp z=1.107. The other two sources are flat-to-negative (Congress net-buy z=-0.48, 8-K z=-0.029), so breadth is thin. Durability is questionable: [P1] says lifecycle 'forming' with POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, and [P2] shows activity ahead of price (divergence z=0.794), which is constructive but early. No news leg [P5] means the activity has not yet been validated by a public catalyst. Continuity is the weakest axis: [P4] relative strength vs SPY is -0.0432 (z=-0.036), essentially flat—price has not confirmed the activity. The two covered members [P6] (ADM, SYY) are a small sample. Verdict: MONITOR—the early activity lead is real but unconfirmed by price and too narrow to enter.
assessments.rationale_zh: 强度中等且来源狭窄。[P3] 显示融合加速度为 2.175，覆盖 4 个来源，但几乎完全由两个来源推动：政府合同 z=1.61 和游说活动上升 z=1.107。另外两个来源持平或为负（国会净买入 z=-0.48，8-K 事件 z=-0.029），因此广度较薄。持久性存疑：[P1] 表明生命周期处于'形成'阶段且出现正向背离，[P2] 显示活动领先于价格（背离 z=0.794），这是建设性的但为时尚早。没有新闻推动 [P5] 意味着活动尚未获得公开催化剂的验证。连续性是最弱的方面：[P4] 相对强度为 -0.0432（z=-0.036），基本持平——价格尚未确认活动。两个覆盖成员 [P6]（ADM、SYY）样本较小。结论：观望——早期活动领先是真实的，但未得到价格确认，且来源过窄，不宜入场。
assessments.rationale_plain: Some real-world activity is stirring across a handful of consumer-staples names—government contract work and lobbying efforts are running well above their normal pace, while the sector's stock prices have barely moved. The activity is narrowly concentrated: most of the signal comes from just two types of sources, and there is no news story yet explaining why it is happening. Because the activity is ahead of price but price has not begun to respond, this is a watch-and-wait situation rather than a clear opportunity.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 少数消费品公司背后的实际活动正在升温——政府合同和游说活动的节奏明显高于正常水平，但该板块的股价几乎没有变化。这些活动来源集中，大部分信号仅来自两类渠道，而且目前还没有新闻解释背后的原因。由于实际活动领先于价格，但价格尚未作出反应，这更像是观察等待的局面，而非明确的入场机会。
assessments.dissent: The strongest case against MONITOR is that this is exactly what a genuine early-stage inflection looks like: fused acceleration is positive, divergence is actively leading price ([P2]), and RADAR already flags POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE in a forming lifecycle ([P1]). Waiting for price confirmation in an equal-weight sector often means buying after the move has begun; the low noise in 8-Ks and Congress flows may simply reflect that those channels lag the real action, not that the signal is weak.

falsifiable_check.confirm: Within 2-4 weeks, relative strength vs broad market turns positive and one of the two covered names (ADM or SYY) appears in a material news flow tied to new government/contract activity.
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Fused acceleration decays below ~1.0 within 2 weeks and relative strength remains flat or negative for 30+ days without any news catalyst emerging.

assessments.name: Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight)

assessments.rationale: Real-activity signal is mixed and narrow. Federal contracts are the strongest source [P3, z=1.14], with grants/loans [P3, z=0.674], lobbying [P3, z=0.476], and Congress net-buy [P3, z=0.437] all positive — but none above ~1.2, and breadth is thin: only 4–5 of 8 sources are meaningfully positive, while federal grant FOAs are deeply negative [P3, z=-2.078] and news flow is negative [P3, z=-0.674]. Fused acceleration is positive [P3, 1.423] but driven by a handful of sources. Durability concerns: the strongest signal (contracts) can be lumpy one-off awards, not a smooth ramp; lobbying is modest [P3, z=0.476] and 8-K events are near zero [P3, z=0.116], suggesting corporate activity is not yet following government interest. Continuity is weak: 60-day relative strength is slightly negative [P4, -0.0935, z=-0.489] and news flow velocity is low with negative acceleration [P5, accel -0.371], so price has not confirmed; the POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE state [P1] exists only because activity leads price, not because price is joining. Verdict is MONITOR: activity is real but not yet broad or accelerating enough to trust persistence, and price has not validated.
assessments.rationale_zh: 真实活动信号混杂且范围狭窄。联邦合同是最强来源 [P3, z=1.14]，赠款/贷款 [P3, z=0.674]、游说 [P3, z=0.476] 和国会净买入 [P3, z=0.437] 均为正，但均未超过约1.2，且广度薄弱：8个来源中仅有4–5个显著为正，联邦赠款FOA深度为负 [P3, z=-2.078]，新闻流为负 [P3, z=-0.674]。融合加速度为正 [P3, 1.423]，但由少数来源驱动。持续性存疑：最强信号（合同）可能是一次性大额授予而非平稳爬坡；游说力度温和 [P3, z=0.476]，8-K事件接近零 [P3, z=0.116]，表明企业活动尚未跟上政府兴趣。连续性弱：60日相对强度略负 [P4, -0.0935, z=-0.489]，新闻流速度低且加速度为负 [P5, accel -0.371]，价格未确认；POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE状态 [P1] 仅因活动领先价格而存在，而非价格正在加入。结论为观察：活动真实但尚不够广泛或加速，不足以信任其持续性，且价格尚未验证。
assessments.rationale_plain: This theme is showing early, uneven signs of real-world activity. Federal contracts are the brightest spot, with grant and loan activity and some lobbying and congressional buying also positive, but the overall picture is mixed — grant funding opportunities have actually dried up sharply, and news coverage is subdued. The companies in this space have not yet translated that interest into meaningful corporate announcements or stock performance; the market has actually lagged slightly over the past two months. This looks like a story that is forming but has not been confirmed by price, so the right posture is to watch for either a broadening of contract and corporate activity or a clear price breakout before committing.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 这个主题在现实世界中显示出早期但不均衡的活动迹象。联邦合同是最明显的亮点，赠款和贷款活动以及部分游说和国会买入也为正，但整体图景是混杂的——赠款融资机会实际上大幅减少，新闻报道也较为平淡。该领域的公司尚未将这种兴趣转化为有意义的企业公告或股价表现；过去两个月市场实际略微落后。这看起来像是一个正在形成但尚未被价格确认的故事，因此正确的姿态是等待合同和企业活动进一步扩大，或等待价格出现明确突破后再介入。
assessments.dissent: The strongest case against MONITOR is that this is exactly how durable themes begin: federal contracts are already positive and accelerating in aggregate [P3, fused accel 1.423], the divergence state [P1] means activity is leading price, and by the time price confirms [P4], the entry will be much worse. Waiting for confirmation could mean missing the entire move if contracts continue to ramp and news flow [P5] turns positive in the next few weeks.

falsifiable_check.confirm: Federal contract z-score rises above ~1.5 AND at least one of 8-K events or news flow turns positive within 30 days, while 60-day relative strength [P4] breaks above zero.
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Federal contract z-score falls below ~0.8 AND grant FOA z-score remains below -1.5, while news flow velocity [P5] stays flat or declines over the next 30 days.

assessments.name: Power & Grid Buildout

assessments.rationale: The radar labels this POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE and forming [P1], and the fused acceleration is positive at 1.378 across 4 sources [P3], but the underlying signal quality is weak. Government contracts are the only meaningful positive source (z=1.133), while lobbying is sharply negative (z=-1.192), Congress net-buy is negligible (z=0.088), and 8-K events are flat (z=0.029) [P3]. The overall divergence z is only 0.392 [P2], so activity is only slightly ahead of price. Price action shows no confirmation: 60-day relative strength is negative (-0.0679, z=-0.259) [P4]. No news leg exists [P5]. Durability is questionable because one strong source (gov contracts) is offset by a declining source (lobbying), suggesting this may be a one-off federal procurement event rather than broad sector momentum. Continuity is middling: the modest positive divergence suggests activity leads price slightly, but the lack of price confirmation [P4] and news [P5] means the narrative is neither confirmed nor fully priced.
assessments.rationale_zh: 雷达标记为正向背离且处于形成期 [P1]，融合加速为正 1.378，涉及 4 个来源 [P3]，但底层信号质量较弱。政府合同是唯一有意义的正向来源（z=1.133），而游说活动显著为负（z=-1.192），国会净买入几乎为零（z=0.088），8-K 事件持平（z=0.029）[P3]。整体背离 z 仅 0.392 [P2]，说明活动仅略领先于价格。价格走势无确认：60 日相对强度为负（-0.0679，z=-0.259）[P4]。无新闻催化 [P5]。持久性存疑，因为一个强来源（政府合同）被一个下降来源（游说）抵消，暗示这可能是联邦采购的一次性事件而非广泛的板块动能。连续性中等：温和的正背离表明活动略领先于价格，但缺乏价格确认 [P4] 和新闻 [P5] 意味着叙事既未被证实也未被充分定价。
assessments.rationale_plain: There is a faint early signal that real activity in consumer discretionary companies is running slightly ahead of their stock prices, driven mainly by government contracts. However, that signal is narrow and partly offset by falling lobbying activity, while trading by lawmakers and corporate filings show almost nothing. Prices have not moved up to confirm it, and there is no news driver behind the theme. This looks like a possible early-stage story worth watching, but it is not strong or broad enough to act on yet.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 有微弱迹象表明，非必需消费品公司的实际活动略领先于股价，主要由政府合同驱动。但该信号狭窄，且被游说活动的下滑部分抵消，而议员交易和公司备案几乎没有动静。股价尚未上涨予以确认，也没有新闻催化。这像是一个值得观察的早期故事，但还不够强、不够广，暂时不宜行动。
assessments.dissent: The strongest case against MONITOR is that the radar's POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE label [P1] and the positive fused acceleration across 4 sources [P3] could signal an early accumulation phase before price catches up. Government contracts are a leading indicator of future revenue, and their z-score of 1.133 [P3] might be the first evidence of a multi-quarter federal spending cycle in autos, electronics, and retail. If so, waiting for price confirmation would mean entering late; the divergence z of 0.392 [P2] is positive, so activity is already ahead. The lack of price confirmation [P4] is precisely the condition under which divergence-based strategies are designed to enter before the crowd.

falsifiable_check.confirm: Government contracts for BBY, F, GM, GRMN increase again in the next 30-60 days and the 60-day relative strength turns positive (z > 0) without a broad market rally, indicating the activity is pulling price up.
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Government contract activity fades back toward zero and the divergence z [P2] falls below 0 while relative strength stays negative [P4], indicating the signal was a one-time procurement event with no follow-through.

assessments.name: Consumer Discretionary (Equal-Weight)

rotation.summary: Rotation is bifurcated: real-activity-led accumulation is forming selectively in early-cycle leaders (semicap equipment, space, and equal-weight comm/staples/discretionary), while fading pressure concentrates in negative-divergence laggards (energy complex, pharma, Mag7, crypto) and confirmed-down cyclical chains.
rotation.summary_zh: 轮动呈分化格局：实际活动驱动的新增积累正在部分早周期领涨主题中形成（半导体设备、航天、通信/必需消费/可选消费等权重板块），而负背离的落后主题（能源、制药、Mag7、加密）以及确认下行的周期链条面临减仓压力。
accumulate: Semiconductor Equipment (WFE) — POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, forming: price still confirming real activity uptrend; rotation into capital-equipment buildout has activity backing.
Space Economy — POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, forming: activity-led recovery underway; not merely price-chasing.
Communication Services (Equal-Weight) — POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, forming: sector-level breadth improving with real activity behind it.
Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight) — POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, forming: defensive but activity-backed; not just risk-off bid.
Power & Grid Buildout — POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, forming: physical infrastructure demand leads price.
Consumer Discretionary (Equal-Weight) — POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, forming: real consumer activity not yet fully priced in.
reduce: Silver Miners — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: price running ahead of industrial/precious demand.
US Energy Complex — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: activity rollover not yet fully priced.
Big Pharma — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: late-cycle defensive bid with deteriorating pipeline/cash-flow signals.
Energy (Equal-Weight) — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: same energy fade in broad sector form.
Insurance & Brokers — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: price detached from underwriting/policy activity.
Magnificent Seven — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: concentration unwind; activity no longer confirms leadership.
GLP-1 & Obesity — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: hype cycle rolling; clinical demand signals not confirming price.
Health Care (Equal-Weight) — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: sector-level activity weakening.
Crypto & Digital Rails — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: price runs ahead of on-chain/real settlement activity.
Financials (Equal-Weight) — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: credit and lending signals deteriorating relative to price.
watch: Cybersecurity — CONFIRMED_UP, mature: if it rolls from confirmed-up to quiet, confirms broad risk appetite shift.
Gold Miners — CONFIRMED_UP, mature: if it decelerates while negative-divergence names stabilize, leadership may rotate back to growth.

AI semantic names (ai_semiconductors, ai_infra, ai_software, ai_agents) — currently QUIET: a move into NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE would signal leadership fully exiting AI capex; a move into POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE would renew AI-led accumulation.
Housing Chain and Critical Minerals — CONFIRMED_DOWN: any bounce without real activity improvement would be a trap; watch for lifecycle transition to quiet/forming.
